Flow.description: Portal flow (Screen Flow: Business License Application Shop). The Shop Application on the portal, for a new shop or salon, a new location, a reopening or a new owner. The applicant (the owner) gives the type of salon, the opening date, the shop's name, phone, addresses, parish and directions, whether a manager license is needed (and the manager's license number), and uploads a copy of their operator's license. On certifying it creates the establishment (a business Account, Establishment record type, with the applicant related as Owner and any manager as Manager) or, for a reopening or new ownership, uses the establishment of the shop license given (a new location is a new establishment, and the old license number goes in the staff note); then a submitted Business License Application (New Establishment, License Type Salon) and the fees from the Fee Schedule: inspection $50, shop license $55, manager $35. As printed, the fees are paid by money order to the inspector at the initial inspection, so there is no online payment step. Keeps a draft until certify, so it can be saved for later for 30 days. Runs in system context; it only uses the signed-in applicant's own records. Staff can also enter it for an applicant from New Application on the Person Account (input recordId); the pay step then tells them to record the payment.

formulas.description: The mailing country: the physical address's when the mailing address is the same.

formulas.name: forT_ApplicantId
formulas.description: The applicant: the person staff chose when they start the form from New Application, otherwise the signed-in portal user.

formulas.name: forB_IsStaffEntry
formulas.description: True when staff are entering the form for an applicant (from New Application).

formulas.name: forB_AbandonedDraft
formulas.description: A draft over a day old that was never saved for later was abandoned.

formulas.name: forT_SavedApplicationUrl
formulas.description: Records this form's interview GUID on the draft, so a saved form can be found again.

formulas.name: forT_BusinessType
formulas.description: The business type name, from the choice's value or label.
formulas.expression: IF(OR({!SH_Type} = "Cosmetology Salon", {!SH_Type} = "Cosmetology"), "Cosmetology Salon", IF(OR({!SH_Type} = "Manicuring Salon", {!SH_Type} = "Manicuring"), "Manicuring Salon", IF(OR({!SH_Type} = "Esthetics Salon", {!SH_Type} = "Esthetics"), "Esthetics Salon", "Home Care Salon")))

formulas.name: forT_ApplicationType
formulas.description: New, New Location, Reopening or New Ownership.

formulas.name: forB_IsInitial
formulas.description: True for a new shop or a new location: each is a new establishment with its own record. A reopening or new ownership continues the existing establishment.

formulas.name: forT_ManagerLicensePrefix
formulas.description: A person's licenses carry their certification number followed by a dash and the license type code (1536380804-C), so a number typed without the code finds them through this prefix.

formulas.name: forT_StaffNote
formulas.expression: TRIM(IF({!forT_ApplicationType} = "New Location", "New location of shop license " & {!forT_CurrentShopLicense} & "; staff to close the old location. ", "") & IF(AND(NOT({!forB_IsInitial}), ISBLANK({!GetCurrentShopLicense.Id})), "Shop license " & {!forT_CurrentShopLicense} & " was not found, so a new establishment was created. ", "") & IF(AND({!forB_NeedManager}, ISBLANK({!varT_ManagerContactId})), "Manager license " & {!forT_ManagerLicense} & " was not found as a current cosmetologist, esthetician or manicurist license, so no manager fee was charged; staff to check it, link the manager and add the fee. ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!GetOperatorLicense.Id}), "Operator license typed by the applicant: " & TRIM({!SD_OperatorTyped}) & ".", ""))

fields.name: SUB_Message
fields.fieldText:
Your shop application has been submitted

To schedule your initial inspection, contact your inspector to set up an appointment for your shop. To avoid delay in processing, please have this form and money order completed prior to the inspector's arrival for your scheduled inspection. If you have any questions, please contact the Louisiana State Board of Cosmetology office at 225-756-3404 for more information.

Have a money order ready for the inspector: $105.00, plus $35.00 if you need a manager license. You can follow your application under My Applications.
